locations.secondary_policy: Keep London only for strong matches

closed_rule: Never mark CLOSED unless the relevant official source was successfully verified in the current run.
source_priority: official ATS or official career site
LinkedIn and aggregators for discovery only
cost_policy: No paid external services or APIs

seniority_policy.6_plus_mandatory: normally exclude unless an unusually strong and credible fit justifies review

fit_thresholds.policy: No maximum number of reported opportunities. Every vacancy meeting the relevant threshold and reporting condition must be surfaced.

purpose: discover vacancies missed by primary ATS/mapping

jd_mapping_policy.policy: A title containing Manager, Senior, Lead, Head or Director must never be rejected by title alone. Read the full JD first. Base inclusion on mandatory years, actual responsibility scope, people-management requirements and role level. Manager titles with <=5 mandatory years or junior/early-mid scope remain eligible.

semantic_analysis_execution.github_role: enumerate inventory, preserve state, generate semantic queue and audit
semantic_analysis_execution.chatgpt_role: open/read full JD, map mandatory vs preferred requirements, assess real seniority and fit, persist decision
semantic_analysis_execution.rule: A run may not claim semantic completeness while semantic_queue contains pending records.
semantic_analysis_execution.title_metadata_rule: ChatGPT may close a role from title/company/location/metadata only when it is clearly impossible to reach the fit threshold.
semantic_analysis_execution.full_jd_rule: Any plausibly relevant role requires full official-JD mapping; business-compatible Manager/Senior/Lead always requires full-JD review and is never excluded by title.

surface_registry_policy.standard_roles: Do not repeat unchanged STILL_OPEN roles after they have been surfaced; re-surface only NEW, materially UPDATED, newly reportable, or explicitly requested.
surface_registry_policy.priority_roles: Amazon in JW2 and Mastercard in JW1 are re-surfaced every daily run while open and in scope.
surface_registry_policy.write_order: Persist semantic decision first; write surfaced history only for roles actually included in the user-visible output; then re-run/sync state when possible.
